postings.description:
About Wheely

Wheely is redefining premium transportation across major cities in Europe, the US, and the Middle East. We blend cutting-edge technology with the craft of five-star chauffeuring to deliver an experience trusted by more than 100,000 active riders and 1,200 corporate accounts.

We’re a profitable, fast-growing scale-up with $43M raised and over $100M in annual revenue. Having recently launched in New York City, we’re expanding rapidly across the US and EMEA. If you take pride in your craft and want to help shape the next chapter of our growth, we'd love to hear from you.
About the role

We are looking for a talented Account Executive with proven track record in working with corporate clients in London. In this role you will be responsible for establishing, growing and maintaining relationships with new and existing partners. This is your opportunity to grow Wheely in the marketplace within your designated industries at an exciting time of its growth.

Responsibilities

- Serve as a Wheely ambassador, exemplifying the brand in interactions with business clients.

- Identify and develop business opportunities, identifying leads from all available channels.

- Transform sales leads into established business accounts within your market.

- Conduct face-to-face meetings to convert potential and existing customers into committed accounts.

- Foster the growth of newly activated accounts.

- Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key accounts to support their expansion.

- Engage in cross-regional collaboration to capture multi-country business opportunities.

- Work closely with internal teams to enhance our service offerings.

- Proven background and network in B2B sales, preferably within:

- Luxury services (e.g., high-end concierge, 5-star hotels, premier luxury brands)

- SaaS B2B sales

- Ride-hailing or chauffeur services

- Elite or private banking sectors

- Demonstrated prowess in proactive sales.

- Exceptional communication abilities, both written and verbal.

- Competency in managing multiple deals and navigating a dynamic startup landscape.

- Independence in work, with a track record of minimal supervision necessity.

- Analytical acumen, capable of evaluating pipeline performance and market dynamics. Familiarity with CRM systems is advantageous.

- A skilled influencer adept at forging new connections and comfortable networking across various levels, from frontline personnel to C-suite executives.

What We Offer

- Office-based role in West London, four days a week with flexible start and finish times, plus one remote day of your choice

- Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus

- Private medical and dental insurance

- Life and critical illness cover

- Best-in-class equipment

- Monthly credit towards Wheely journeys

- Cycle to Work scheme

- Professional development stipend

postings.title: Business Development Representative (Chauffeur - Partner)
postings.description:
About Wheely

Wheely is redefining premium transportation across major cities in Europe, the US, and the Middle East. We blend cutting-edge technology with the craft of five-star chauffeuring to deliver an experience trusted by more than 100,000 active riders and 1,200 corporate accounts.

We’re a profitable, fast-growing scale-up with $43M raised and over $100M in annual revenue. Having recently launched in New York City, we’re expanding rapidly across the US and EMEA. If you take pride in your craft and want to help shape the next chapter of our growth, we'd love to hear from you.
About The Role

As a Business Development Representative (Chauffeur - Partner) in Paris, you'll own Wheely France's chauffeur acquisition engine end to end — from first contact to first journey. Sitting within the France Operations team, you'll build and run the pipeline that keeps the marketplace supplied with best-in-class chauffeurs, using data to prioritise where and how we recruit.

This is an execution-heavy, high-ownership role, not a strategy-only seat: you'll be judged on pipeline volume, conversion, and time-to-first-journey.

Why This Role

- High-growth business. Wheely France is scaling fast and expanding into new markets — chauffeur supply is the #1 constraint on that growth, and you'll own the lever that unlocks it.

- Direct impact. Every chauffeur you convert is a measurable addition to marketplace supply — your funnel numbers move the business.

- Real ownership. You'll run the acquisition funnel yourself: sourcing, qualification, conversion, and the systems that support them.

Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end chauffeur acquisition funnel: sourcing, screening, qualifying, and converting leads through calls, emails, and in-person meetings.

- Build and manage a high-volume acquisition pipeline, tracking each chauffeur's progress from sign-up to first journey.

- Use data to identify where acquisition is underperforming — by channel, city, or funnel stage — and design fixes.

- Partner with Quality & Training (Chauffeur Academy) to ensure a smooth handoff from acquisition to onboarding.

- Act as a day-to-day representative for Wheely within the chauffeur community, building relationships that support referrals and retention.

- Report acquisition funnel performance (volume, conversion, cost, time-to-first-journey) to France Ops leadership.

Requirements

- Experience running high-volume sales pipelines, with the discipline to manage many leads at different funnel stages at once.

- Comfortable with data — able to track and report funnel metrics, and act on them (SQL a plus, not required).

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to engage at scale while keeping a personal touch.

- A structured operator who turns a high-volume, high-touch process into a repeatable system.

- Fluent French and English.

- Based in Paris, ability to work in the office 5 days a week.

What We Offer

- Office-based role in Paris (9th arrondissement)

- Competitive salary of up to €42,000/year (dependent on role level)

- Quarterly KPI-based bonus

- Private medical insurance

- Life and critical illness cover

- Best-in-class equipment

- Monthly credit towards Wheely journeys

- Daily Lunch Allowance

- Navigo and Veligo travel

- Professional development stipend

All of your personal information will be collected stored and processed in accordance with Wheely’s Candidate Privacy Notice

- Set the strategy. Decide which segments, markets and channels to prioritise, how to position and price for each, and where to invest. Corporate clients, hotels and private aviation partners have different needs and buying processes.

- Build the US commercial team. Hire and lead sales and account management in the US as we scale city by city.

- Grow existing clients. Expand within our current accounts. Many of our London clients have major US operations, and winning those offices is a core early priority.

- Build marketing and customer success from scratch. Including account-based marketing, events, and our relationships with executive assistants, who are often our most important users.

- Own the W4B product roadmap. Lead our dedicated product squad to deliver what clients and partners need: integrations with booking and expense tools, approval flows, reporting, and security certifications.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Leadership people want to follow, with the ability to develop the existing team while hiring new talent.

- Meaningful experience in the US market: building a team, selling to US clients, or leading a business there.

This is a fantastic opportunity for hospitality professionals looking to transition into the tech sector. You will enjoy more regular hours without losing the fast-paced, luxury-service style of working. You will combine your expertise in luxury hospitality with a practical, operational approach, directly influencing the quality of service delivered to our passengers.

We regularly recruit experienced leaders from five-star hospitality brands such as Four Seasons and Jumeirah, as well as from premium airline and private aviation environments, including Emirates. These professionals thrive at Wheely by applying rigorous hospitality standards in a fast-moving, operationally focused setting. Our partnership with Forbes Travel Guide further reinforces our commitment to world-class training and service excellence.

This is not a traditional HR or classroom-only L&D role. You will be deeply embedded in operations, working directly with chauffeurs, assessing real-world performance, and intervening where standards are not met. Your work will play a critical role in protecting Wheely’s reputation and ensuring a consistently exceptional passenger experience as the business grows.

Responsibilities

Training & Standards

- Own the end-to-end training of Wheely chauffeurs, ensuring a consistently flawless, five-star luxury experience.

- Deliver engaging and practical training to experienced professionals.

- Adapt and localise Wheely’s global training content to meet local market needs while maintaining brand consistency.

Continuous Improvement

- Build and maintain a strong feedback loop between training, quality, operations, and customer support.

- Partner with peers in other regions to share best practices and raise global service standards.

- Act as a guardian of Wheely’s luxury positioning, ensuring service quality remains consistently high as the business grows.

Requirements

You take personal pride in high standards and believe luxury is delivered through consistency, discipline, and attention to detail.

- 3+ years of experience delivering high-quality group or classroom training to experienced professionals.

- 2+ years in a customer-facing luxury environment, such as five-star hospitality, premium or private aviation, luxury services, or retail.

- Proven ability to coach, influence, and challenge others while maintaining trust and credibility.

- A hands-on approach to training with the ability to work directly with individuals to improve performance.

- A passion for luxury vehicles and knowledge of their specifications is a plus.
